Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly inferred batting handedness from bowling style, assuming “left-arm fast” implied a left-handed batsman. This is a logical error; bowling arm does not determine batting hand. Despite noting that multiple sources list Wahab Riaz as right-handed and having search results pointing to such profiles (e.g., cricket.com.au, CREX), the Planner prematurely concluded “left-handed” and attempted to finish without verifying via a reliable profile, leading directly to the wrong answer.
